look: a male goblin with olive-green skin, a big bald head, very large pointed ears, a long hooked nose and a small wiry pot-bellied body with thin sinewy arms
line_words: thin, crisp, dark green contour line
arms_paint: narrow bony shoulders across the shoulder band; level thin sinewy arms with a slight elbow and a slender forearm
hands_paint: each hand with five long thin fingers, knuckles and short fingernails
face_paint: the head as a big bald scalp with a few faint darker mottled spots and, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural goblin face strongly foreshortened from above, a sly scowling wrinkled brow over shadowed eye slits, a long hooked nose that warms from olive-green to a dull tan at its tip, and a narrow jaw with its two tiny fangs; each big ear a thin leaf of skin with a shallow dull pink-brown inner hollow
torso_tilt: the big head covers most of it, so only the outer edges of a narrow wiry chest show beside the jaw, and under the chin a thin rim of a small round belly.
torso_paint: the torso as the narrow edges of a wiry chest beside the jaw and the thin rim of a small round belly under the chin
notes: painter: legacy = bald olive-green male, pink-brown ear hollows, tan-tipped hooked nose, two lower fangs, wiry arms, pot belly. Head (legacy size) hides nearly all the torso at this camera.
